ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is triangle UTV, point U is on the left side, point T is above, and point V is at the lower right. Side UT and side TV each have one identical notch, indicating UT = TV. The angle mark at vertex T is 74°. Reasoning: Because UT = TV, triangle UTV is an isosceles triangle, the base is UV, and the base angles ∠TUV and ∠UVT are equal. The sum of the interior angles of a triangle is 180°, so the sum of the two base angles is 180° − 74° = 106°. Therefore each base angle is 106° ÷ 2 = 53°. So m∠TUV = 53°.
